evidence_items.explanation: Confirms Minerva's multiplication accuracy was measured by number of digits (Figure 8, x-axis 'Average number of digits in solution'). The plotted values are not in the text, so the 4-digit result cannot be quoted.

receipt.public_excerpt: Lewkowycz et al. (2022) conducted a digit study and highlighted that Minerva is unable to per- form any multiplication of numbers with more than seven digits.

evidence_items.explanation: A secondary summary of Minerva's Figure 8. It puts the failure point at 'more than seven digits', probably digits in the answer. A 4x4-digit product has 7 or 8 digits, so this is consistent with near-total failure on 4-digit multiplication, but it does not state it.

unresolved_gaps: Minerva's Figure 8 gives multiplication accuracy only as a plotted curve. No text states the accuracy for 4-digit multiplication.
The secondary summary's 'more than seven digits' is ambiguous between operand digits and solution digits, and does not cover 7-digit products.
I found no independent evaluation of Minerva on 4x4-digit multiplication. Minerva was never publicly released.
